label: StudyE12-admission: OFFLINE ANALYSIS OF COMMITTED RESULTS (StudyD14 traces). CPU only on flash; no GPU, no model server, no inference. Evaluation is the Nexar AP on continuous log P(Yes) scores; the per-episode utility is a TRAINING target for the admission ranking only and is never an evaluation metric.
excluded_features: time since the standing query began
clip metadata (scene, light, weather) - primary predictor

b_shuffle_features_within_fold.description: each trigger's feature vector is replaced by one drawn uniformly from that fold's pool of trigger feature vectors (seed 0), which breaks the feature-label association while preserving the marginal feature distribution. Labels, cutoff procedure and budget are unchanged. P-trajectory must fall to P-random's level.

a_budget_1_equals_admit_all.description: At budget 1.0 every policy must equal admit-all exactly (AP at h=0, invocations, fraction of positives alarmed, false alarms per clip-hour).
